column1: # Real-world size bands and the sockets each archetype needs (docs/AGENT_ASSET_STORE.md §7),
# read by `asset_edit action=check`: `size_band`, `socket_missing`. An asset's archetype is the
# last word of its name listed here (`wall_torch`: torch; a plural counts), else its first tag. A
# name with a group or part word (stack, pile, cluster, rack, lid ...: GROUP in
# crates/pav_core/src/props/lint.rs) has none, and a word does not count when the asset's
# category is another kind than `cats` (town and dungeon fit every archetype). Bands are
# generous: they catch a 32 cm table, not a low one. measure: height (y) or length (the longest
# side, for held things); wide: the most either side of the footprint may be; socket: what a
# format-2 asset of the archetype must have. `-`: none.
